availability.note: bydautomotive.com.au/configurator 301-redirects to this BYD Build & Price flow; lists exactly two grades, Essential $33,990 and Premium $37,990, on 2026-11-26

listPrice.note: BYD's own configurator shows $33,990 (unlabelled; its drive-away figure is computed separately per state). CarExpert price-and-specs and RACV say 'before on-road costs' / 'excl. on-road costs' in words for the same figure. RACV's Victorian drive-away estimate $36,291.70 vs app round-trip $36,297.58 (green-car duty), $6 gap, corroborating a list price

batteryKwh.note: BYD AU / CarExpert 12.9 kWh LFP; BYD UK quotes 12.96 kWh for the same pack. Nominal capacity: no source states usable vs gross

rangeKm.note: BYD UK Comfort (same pack, 18-inch wheels as AU) WLTP electric range 38.5 miles = 62 km. BYD AU/CarExpert quote 71 km NEDC: higher than WLTP, so rejected per the direction test

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 12.9/62 x 100; no published EV-mode WLTP figure readable (BYD Ireland MY26 guide lists one but its digits did not extract)

combinedRangeKm.note: WLTP electric 62 km + 52 L tank (CarExpert, BYD UK) / 4.5 L/100km x 100 = 1217.6, rounded

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: BYD AU published charge-sustaining claim (4.5 L/100km with battery below 25%), NEDC-basis. Kept for consistency with byd-sealion-6, whose rows use the same BYD AU basis. BYD UK lists 51.4 mpg (~5.5 L/100km) WLTP combined for both grades, likely the WLTP charge-sustaining figure; Chasing Cars recorded 8.1 L/100km on country roads

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: combined label 'as low as 1.2L/100km' (Essential; CarExpert gives 1.2 for this grade), at or below 3.5

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO: green passenger car = combined tailpipe CO2 <= 120 g/km; a 1.2 L/100km label is roughly 28-30 g/km

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: BYD AU spec 463 L, matched by BYD UK; measurement method unlabelled (BYD Ireland guide's boot diagram references the parcel shelf, consistent with to-the-cover)

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: BYD AU spec 1,410 L, matched by BYD UK and RACV; method unlabelled

towKg.note: RACV: maximum braked towing capacity limited to 750kg; no BYD AU technical sheet found

warrantyYears.note: 6 years/150,000 km vehicle; 8 years/160,000 km traction battery

insuranceAnnual.note: raised from held 1250/1320 to align with today's refreshed siblings: chery-tiggo-7-phev-urban ($37,990, $1,450), geely-starray-em-i-complete ($37,490, $1,500), byd-sealion-6-essential ($42,990, $1,450); Essential set $100 below Premium

depreciationCurve.note: BYD brand curve [1,0.74,0.63,0.55,0.48,0.42] used on 17 BYD rows including byd-sealion-6; one curve per brand (owner convention). byd-atto3 alone uses a steeper family curve
